originality.rationale: The claimed object is the *entire* set of named two-colour strong-majority edge colourings of Q_d for every d≥4, not the already-known cubic Q3 case or a general three-colour existence bound. value.rationale: The precise set of all optimal colourings of every high-dimensional hypercube is a natural exact classification for a new edge-colouring invariant, revealing coordinate-parity rigidity and exponentially many (but only 2^d out of 2^(d*2^(d-1))) admissible labelled patterns. These facts are not a routine restatement of the known 3-colour high-degree sufficient bound, and the spectral rigidity method may be useful for other Cartesian-product problems.
